nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the man from <Picture 1>, with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a grey zip-up fleece over a light-colored patterned sweater.
<Subject 2> is the wooden owl held by <Subject 1> in <Picture 1>; it maintains its carved wooden texture and size but becomes animated with bird-like wing movements.
<Subject 3> is the girl from <Picture 3>, with long dark hair, wearing a vibrant floral-patterned bomber jacket and blue patterned pajama pants.
<Picture 1> is the initial scene in the hallway featuring the man holding the owl.
<Picture 2> is the room seen through the doorway, containing a rug, desk, and various items; it serves as the destination environment.

summary:
[reference generation + video continuation] The wooden owl (<Subject 2>) held by <Subject 1> in <Picture 1> comes to life and flies through a doorway into the room shown in <Picture 2>, eventually landing on the head of <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved - the man's facial features, glasses, and clothing are retained.
<Subject 2>: attribute_transfer - the carved wooden texture is preserved while its state changes from static to animated.
<Subject 3>: fully_preserved - the girl's likeness, long dark hair, and colorful floral jacket are retained.
<Picture 1>: fully_preserved - the starting composition of the man in the hallway is used as the anchor for [Shot 1].
<Picture 2>: fully_preserved - the room layout, including the rug and furniture, is preserved as the destination scene.

detailed_description:
Cinematic live-action style with natural indoor lighting.
[Shot 1] A medium shot frames <Subject 1>, a man with short brown hair and glasses wearing a grey fleece over a light sweater, as he holds <Subject 2>, a small carved wooden owl, in his hands. Suddenly, the wooden owl's wings begin to flap with organic bird-like motions, though its texture remains entirely hard, polished wood.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.500, the camera pans right at fast speed, tracking <Subject 2> as it takes flight from <Subject 1>'s hands and moves toward the right side of the frame. The camera follows the owl's trajectory closely, rotating until the view is perpendicular (90 degrees) to the original hallway perspective. This movement smoothly reveals the doorway leading into the room anchored by <Picture 2>.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.500, the shot continues tracking <Subject 2> as it glides through the doorway and into the room from <Picture 2>. <Subject 3>, the girl with long dark hair in a floral bomber jacket, is standing in the center of the room at the white spot. The owl flies directly toward her head.
[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of <Subject 3> standing in <picture 2>. The wooden owl (<Subject 2>) lands gently on top of her head. <Subject 3> looks up slightly and breaks into a wide, joyful smile, clearly enjoying the magical moment.

overall_soundscape:
Soft indoor room tone with the rhythmic, light tapping sound of wooden wings flapping against each other as the owl flies.

non_diegetic_music:
A whimsical, light orchestral swell with soft woodwinds that rises in volume as the owl takes flight and reaches its destination.

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the primary reference image for the entire scene, serving as the first frame and anchor.
<Subject 1> is the woman from <Picture 1>, featuring wet hair, a grey ribbed tank top, cargo pants with fabric wraps around her waist and arms, and a determined expression.
<Subject 2> is the long piece of weathered driftwood held by <Subject 1>.
<Subject 3> is the coastal environment shown in <Picture 1>, including the rocky shoreline, white-capped ocean waves, and the blue sky with light clouds.

summary:
[keyframe completion + reference generation] The video captures a "bullet time" moment where the entire scene from <Picture 1> is frozen perfectly in time while the camera performs a smooth orbital rotation around <Subject 1>.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> ([Shot 1] first frame): fully_preserved - serves as the initial composition and anchor for all elements.
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - remains perfectly motionless, with no change in expression, posture, or breathing throughout the duration.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - stays fixed in <Subject 1>'s hands as she is frozen.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the background remains static while the camera moves through the space.

detailed_description:
The video is a cinematic live-action shot with high-detail textures and natural lighting, capturing a "bullet time" effect.
[Shot 1] The scene begins exactly as <Picture 1>, where every element is frozen in time. <Subject 1> stands completely motionless; her wet hair is locked in place, her grey tank top shows no movement from breathing, and her grip on the driftwood (<Subject 2>) remains steady. There is zero change in her facial expression or body posture for the entire 5 seconds. The camera performs a continuous orbital arc shot, rotating 360 degrees around <Subject 1> at a slow and smooth speed. As the camera orbits, it reveals the depth of the coastal environment (<Subject 3>), showcasing the texture of the rocks and the frozen spray of the waves from every angle. The lighting remains consistent as the perspective shifts, highlighting the moisture on her skin and the grain of the wood in <Subject 2>.

overall_soundscape:
A subtle, ethereal atmospheric hum that emphasizes the "frozen" state of the scene, with a very faint crystalline shimmer.

non_diegetic_music:
A slow, cinematic orchestral swell featuring a sustained cello note that feels suspended in time, providing a sense of weight to the frozen moment.
